quartermaster.name: Quartermaster
quartermaster.greeting: The Depths need thinning, adventurer. Bring me proof of your kills.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.greeting: Coin for gear, adventurer? Have a look at my wares.

healer.name: Healer
healer.greeting: You look worn thin. Rest here a while, for a little coin.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.greeting: I deal in knowledge, not steel. A spellbook, perhaps -- if your purse allows it.

guide.name: Frontier Guide
guide.greeting: The frontier's bigger than the Wastes alone, if you can prove yourself to me.
